Winner of the 1990 International Tchaikovsky Competition in Moscow, Berezovsky interprets the works of Rimsky-Korsakov with a virtuosic power. The programme features The Tale of the Invisible City of Kitezh and the Maiden Fevroniya, suite for orchestra, as well as The Tale of Tsar Saltan, musical pictures for orchestra. It is produced by the Moscow Philharmonic Society, which Saint Petersburg-born composer Dmitri Shostakovich himself once described as playing a significant role "in the development of musical life [in Russia]. It is a kind of university which is attended by millions of music lovers and thousands of musicians. The Moscow Philharmonic Society was founded in 1922 by then-Commissar for Culture, Anatoly Lunacharsky, and has over the years come to be Russia's leading concert organizing institution.

programme.title: A Mozart Concert from Berlin
programme.desc: The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra delivers a program entirely devoted to Mozart at the Konzerthaus in Berlin under the direction of Hartmut Haenchen. On the program: Divertimento, Concerto for Piano and Orchestra No. 20, and Symphony No. 41. The Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Chamber Orchestra delivers a program entirely devoted to Mozart at the Konzerthaus in Berlin under the direction of Hartmut Haenchen. In reduced form, the ensemble manages to bring to life the many characteristics of the music and the unique spirit of the famous composer, be it his gaiety of heart, his lyricism, his dramatic side or his polyphonic writing inspired. Criticism has always praised Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach's stylistic assurance, transparency of textures and technical precision. The extraordinary sensitivity and ease of Stefan Vladar make him an ideal partner for Haenchen and his orchestra. The evening's program includes Divertimento, K. 113; the Concerto for Piano and Orchestra No. 20, K. 466, and Symphony No. 41, K. 551.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 is widely considered Beethoven’s greatest composition. He completed this symphony in 1824, when he was almost completely deaf. This symphony is unique, since Beethoven included a choir and vocal soloists in the last movement, in which he set parts of Friedrich Schiller's poem Ode an die Freude (Ode to Joy) to music. The symphony consists of four movements: Allegro ma non troppo, un poco maestoso, Molto vivace, Adagio molto e cantabile, and Finale. The four vocal soloists are Gulnara Shafigullina (soprano), Claire Barnett-Jones (mezzosoprano), Matthew Newlin (tenor), and Frederik Bergman (baritone).

Pieces include Piano Concerto No. 25 in C major, Sinfonia concertante in E-flat major, K. 364, arias and scenes from Così fan tutte, Le nozze di Figaro, The Magic Flute and Symphony No. 35 in D major, K. 385 ("Haffner").

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Dvořák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program featuring Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338, and Antonín Dvořák’s Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021. Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone). This performance was recorded at Barbican Hall in London, on February 16, 2020. Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone). Engineered with unmatched symphonic finesse, Beethoven set aside ruminations on fate and heroism to compose his utterly musical and wholly satisfying Ninth Symphony. It is a monumental work, renowned for its innovative use of a chorus and vocal soloists in the final movement, singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem "Ode to Joy". Premiered in 1824, it remains one of the most performed and recognizable pieces of classical music. This performance was recorded at Barbican Hall in London, on February 16, 2020.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar’s Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final I: Liszt and Ravel
programme.desc: As part of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), Josef Edoardo Mossali (Italy, 2001) performs Franz Liszt’s Après une Lecture de Dante: Fantasia quasi Sonata; Maurice Ravel’s Toccata from Le tombeau de Couperin; and Etude No. 3 La Campanella from Liszt’s Six Grandes études de Paganini. This performance was recorded at Teatro EDI Barrio’s in Milan, in February 2020. Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Josef Edoardo Mossali (Italy, 2001) performs Franz Liszt’s Après une Lecture de Dante: Fantasia quasi Sonata; Maurice Ravel’s Toccata from Le tombeau de Couperin; and Etude No. 3 La Campanella from Liszt’s Six Grandes études de Paganini. This performance was recorded at Teatro EDI Barrio’s in Milan, in February 2020.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in Handel’s oratorio Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno (The Triumph of Time and Truth). Sabine Devieilhe and Franco Fagioli are the main singers. Recorded at the Festival d’Aix-en-Provence in 2016. Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging. In this oratorio, the characters Time and Disillusion try to convince Beauty to abandon Pleasure for less fleeting gratifications. Sabine Devieilhe is unquestionably the star that carries the show, always impressive in technique, range and timbre. Her sparring and harmonizing with Franco Fagioli is magnificent. Other soloists are Michael Spyres and Sara Mingardo. Recorded at the Festival d’Aix-en-Provence in 2016.

programme.title: Maša i Medvjed
programme.desc: Animirani serijal prati pustolovine simpatične djevojčice Maše i Medvjeda, koji postanu prijatelji. Maša je hiperaktivna djevojčica dobrog srca, koja se izgubila u šumi, gdje je zalutala u Medvjedovu kuću, koji se od tada brine o njoj. Zajedno dožive brojne komične zgode, u koje Maša upadne zbog svoje razigranosti i znatiželje.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. programme.title: Maša i Medvjed
programme.desc: Animirani serijal prati pustolovine simpatične djevojčice Maše i Medvjeda, koji postanu prijatelji. Maša je hiperaktivna djevojčica dobrog srca, koja se izgubila u šumi, gdje je zalutala u Medvjedovu kuću, koji se od tada brine o njoj. programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.desc: Centralna informativna emisija televizije Pink predstavlja spoj iskusnih urednika sa tradicijom, i mladih novinara koji prate duh vremena. Tim koji pobeđuje svakodnevno, 365 dana u godini kreira program, koji je prema agenciji Nielsen, najgledaniji centralno informativni program svih komercijalnih emitera u Srbiji.

programme.title: PREMIJERA: vikend specijal
programme.desc: Za "Premijeru vikend specijal" govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde, a čine je i aktuelne vesti iz sveta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije svake nedelje priprema televizijski maraton i retrospektivu prethodne nedelje, uz sve važne vesti iz života poznatih i aktulenosti iz Srbije i regiona. Osim novog studija i dobro poznatih rubrika - "Pričalo se o...", "Dogodilo se", "Premotavanje", "Sa lica mesta", "Beograd noću", "Dan za nama", "Njihovih 1800 sekundi sa Nemanjom", "Nedeljno popodne sa..." i "Muzički kutak" - sedma sezona "Premijera - Vikend specijala" doneće i potpuno nove rubrike u svakoj emisiji.

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Seljaci, serija
programme.desc: Serija "Seljaci" je saga o nekoliko seoskih porodica koje žive u našem selu Treskavica, a čiji su mnogi članovi rasuti po svetu od Pariza do Novog Zelanda. Dolazi do mešanja starih i novih običaja i navika, što je izvor mnogih konfliktnih i komičnih situacija. Zašto gledaoci vole da gledaju seriju "Seljaci"? Zato što je autentična, naša, što sa blagom ironijom i humorom govori o našim manama i lošim navikama, a sa velikom simpatijom o našim tradicionalnim vrednostima...

programme.desc: Serija "Seljaci" je saga o nekoliko seoskih porodica koje žive u našem selu Treskavica, a čiji su mnogi članovi rasuti po svetu od Pariza do Novog Zelanda. Zato što je autentična, naša, što sa blagom ironijom i humorom govori o našim manama i lošim navikama, a sa velikom simpatijom o našim tradicionalnim vrednostima...

programme.title: Neki bolji ljudi, serija
programme.desc: Neki bolji ljudi porodična je serija čije glavne junake predstavljaju članovi porodice Urošević i Graovac. Dramsku radnju pokreću događaji koji protagoniste dovode u situacije kroz koje će se ispoljiti njihovi lični interesi i ambicije, prožeti jakim međusobnim emocijama. Tri generacije pod jednim krovom, u komšijskim stanovima Graovac i Urošević, predstavljaju idealan teren za sukobe generacija i sistema vrednosti ali i fini humor. Đuro i njegova žena Jovanka pripadaju posleratnoj, bejbi bum generaciji koja se školovala, radila i vaspitala decu u socijalističkom duhu. Dragan i Marija su predstavnici generacije X koja je najbolje godine svog života potrošila tokom devedesetih godina 20 veka prošlog veka. I dok je Marija uspela da se visoko pozicionira u poslovnoj hijerarhiji, Dragan je prihvatio ulogu domaćice u kući. Nikola, Sara i Filip su deca novog milenijuma, generacija kojoj je život na mreži podjednako važan kao i realnost. Ipak, kad ih sustignu iskonski porivi, kao što je ljubav, biće prinuđeni da se okrenu sebi i suoče sa osećanjima. Tada polako počinju shvatati da se u virtuelnom svetu ne možeš sakriti od stvarnosti. Porodica Graovac - Urošević je pod konstantnim pritiskom s kojim se mosi kako zna i ume, a prilično često niti zna, niti ume. Decu pritiskaju izazovi i iskušenja odrastanja, očekivanja roditelja i sami roditelji; roditelje pritiskaju bračni problemi i deca, a babu i dedu - porodični i egzistencijalni problemi. Kako će se naši junaci sa njima nositi i da li će posle svega postati neki bolji ljudi, ostaje da se vidi.

programme.title: Sarajevski atentat, film
programme.desc: Atentat Gavrila Principa na austrijskog prijestolonasljednika Franju Ferdinanda u lipnju 1914. godine u Sarajevu imao je dalekosežne povijesne posljedice. Okvir ove teme čini osobna drama jednog od sudionika u atentatu koji životnu kataklizmu počinje u tim dramatičnim danima 1914. godine, a završava na kraju II svjetskog rata.

programme.title: Otac na službenom putu, film
programme.desc: Drama o sarajevskoj obitelji traumatiziranoj antistaljinističkim čistkama. Sarajevo, lipanj 1950., vrijeme pritiska SSSR-a i zemalja Informbiroa na socijalističku Jugoslaviju. Trgovački putnik i komunist Meša veliki je ženskar, usprkos tome što ima privlačnu ženu i dvoje djece koja ga vole. Ljubavnici Ankici dugo je mazao oči kako će se razvesti, no kad ona napokon shvati da to nikad neće učiniti, prijavi usputnu Mešinu opasku o pretjerivanju u antistaljinističkoj propagandi oznaškom čelniku Ziji, rođenom bratu Mešine žene Sene. Zijo, kojem Ankica postaje priležnica, smjesta pošalje Mešu u zatvor, pri čemu djeci kažu da je tata otišao na službeni put. Otada mlađi Mešin i Senin sin, šestogodišnji Malik, postaje mjesečar... Četiri godine nakon velikog uspjeha svog debitantskog uratka Sjećaš li se Dolly Bell?, s kojim je u Veneciji osvojio prvu nagradu za najbolji debitantski film, Emir Kusturica, ponovno surađujući s Abdulahom Sidranom kao scenaristom, polučio je još veći uspjeh filmom Otac na službenom putu. Film je trijumfirao na na prestižnom canneskom festivalu, a bio je i nominiran za Oscara u kategoriji najboljeg filma izvan engleskog govornog područja. Prije nekoliko godina, u anketi bosanskohercegovačkih filmskih kritičara, svrstan je na treće mjesto najboljih bosanskih filmova svih vremena (iza Sjećaš li se Dolly Bell? i Žene s krajolikom, tv-filma Ivice Matića).

programme.title: Kuduz, film
programme.desc: U sumornom ambijentu gradske periferije počinje priča o lokalnoj zavodnici koja se udaje za doskorašnjeg robijaša Kuduza (Slobodan Ćustić), čovjeka kojeg razapinju strasti. Početni nesporazumi i praštanja između supružnika, a zatim potjere i svađe, mirenja i molbe, neminovno vode ovu vezu dvoje ljudi elementarnog naboja tragičnom završetku. On će izvršiti zločin. Za sve vrijeme ove burne veze odvija se plemenita, nježna i kristalno čista ljubav između poočima Kuduza i njegove petogodišnje pastorke.

programme.title: Creed 2, film
programme.desc: Život je za Adonisa Creeda (Michael B. Jordan) postao pitanje balansiranja. Između osobnih obveza i treninga za sljedeću borbu, suprotstavljen je izazovu svog života. Suočavanje s protivnikom vezanim uz prošlost njegove obitelji samo pooštrava njegovu predstojeću bitku u ringu. Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) uz njega je kroz sve to i zajedno će se suočiti sa svojim zajedničkim nasljeđem te ispitati za što se vrijedi boriti i otkriti da ništa nije važnije od obitelji.

programme.title: Prvi Nacionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: Centralna informativna emisija televizije Pink predstavlja spoj iskusnih urednika sa tradicijom, i mladih novinara koji prate duh vremena. Tim koji pobeđuje svakodnevno, 365 dana u godini kreira program, koji je prema agenciji Nielsen, najgledaniji centralno informativni program svih komercijalnih emitera u Srbiji.

programme.title: PREMIJERA: vikend specijal
programme.desc: Za "Premijeru vikend specijal" govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvezde, a čine je i aktuelne vesti iz sveta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije svake nedelje priprema televizijski maraton i retrospektivu prethodne nedelje, uz sve važne vesti iz života poznatih i aktulenosti iz Srbije i regiona. Osim novog studija i dobro poznatih rubrika - "Pričalo se o...", "Dogodilo se", "Premotavanje", "Sa lica mesta", "Beograd noću", "Dan za nama", "Njihovih 1800 sekundi sa Nemanjom", "Nedeljno popodne sa..." i "Muzički kutak" - sedma sezona "Premijera - Vikend specijala" doneće i potpuno nove rubrike u svakoj emisiji.

programme.title: Kafanica blizu SIS-a, serija
programme.desc: Već znamo da je "Agencija za sve i svašta" vlasotinačko preduzeće koje rešava sve probleme svojih klijenata. Osnivač i vlasnik firme je Spiridon Don Karamarković, nekadašnji pripadnik Legije stranaca, ekspert za sva pitanja i najškrtiji gazda na svetu. Deda mu je rekao da svaki uspešan Srbin mora da ima kafanu i on je ove godine osnovao svoju. Poslove oko kafane poverio je misterioznoj Madam Žaklini koja je naše gore list, ali je ugostiteljsko znanje sticala u Parizu.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2017 - Sprint World Cup Part 3
programme.desc: The International Canoe Federation (ICF) is the world governing body responsible for administering the sport of Canoeing, which includes both canoeing and kayaking. Governing eight disciplines, two of which are Olympic sports (Canoe Sprint and Canoe Slalom); the ICF delights us with competitions for these sports.While canoe slalom is a timed event where competitors navigate a whitewater course by passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates, canoe sprint is a race to the line on a flatwater course. Both present a challenge for which athletes spend months, if not years, preparing for.Watch this extreme water sport and the two disciplines that take place in the Olympics: sprints and slalom.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup, 2018 - Sprint 1 World Cup Szeged
programme.desc: The Sprint World Cup from the International Canoe Federation starts in Szeged, in the south of Hungary. This is the first Sprint World Cup of the 2018 season, and 700 athletes from 62 nations have been battling it out for the top spot. Who will raise to the top as the best nation in the sport? Find out on the highlights of the 2018 Sprint World Cup 1 Szeged.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: After making their debut in indomitable style in 2014, the unique flying catamarans literally "took off" on their first European Circuit in 2015. Building on the success of the America's Cup foiling catamarans, the GC32 takes the thrill of foiling to an extraordinary performance level in a fiercely fought five stage circuit raced across five iconic venues in Italy, Spain and France.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: 2019 - - Portrait of Les Voiles De St Tropez Welcome to the 20th edition of Les Voiles de St. Tropez. The legendary bay of Brigitte Bardot is home one more time to one of the most glamorous regattas in the world. Here, more than 200 Classic and modern yachts sail side by side in the golden Saint Tropez to win this delightful competition.

programme.title: Mr. Price Pro Ballito
programme.desc: Follow the world leaders of surfing as they come to South Africa, Willard beach Ballito. 96 competitors from 18 countries will surf for the 250,000$ prize. Also, music concerts filled with South African bands will be cheering the best surfers of the world with their jamming.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: 2022 - : Šibenik, Murter, NP Krka, Vodice Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: A Surfing Life: David Van Zyl
programme.desc: David Van Zyl is a young South-African surfer that is quickly gaining popularity and becoming a rising star on the pro-surfer scene. For surf connoisseurs, his name has made history in 2019 as the first International Surfer to ever win the Vans Pro competition in Hawaii. Before then, Hawaiian surfers had an undefeated upper hand that was finally overcome by this young underdog. He now faces new challenges to engrave his name in fame.Get ready to catch some South African waves with David Van Zyl and find out more about his lifestyle on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Vodice is a famous tourist destination known for many breathtaking beaches and vibrant and rich offer of all tourist attractions. It is known for its liveliness and its friendly hosts. Located on the coast in a wide bay, 11 km northwest ofŠibenik, it is the ideal vacation spot for everyone. Check it out in this episode of Sail-ho Croatia!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The region of Imotski is a historical name for the area. We are determined in today's episode to visit this region and a town straight out of a fairytale - magical Imotski. We’ll indulge in natural beauties and set off across the sea to the islands of Iž, Molat and Dugi otok. Stay with us and find out more about this wonderful area!

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Kite Masters is a series showcasing the latest news from the inspirational world of kite boarding - the action packed sport which continues to take the world by storm. Whether you are a kiteboarder - competitor or recreational, kiteboarding fan, interested observer or have ever wanted to give kiteboarding a go, then you are guaranteed to enjoy the Kite Masters series. There are a myriad of different disciplines in kiteboarding - racing to freestyle - for weekend warriors and the professional riders. Kite Masters checks in on them all and brings you the best round up of action from around the world.

programme.title: 52 Super Series
programme.desc: 2026 - - 52 Super Series Sailing Week Established as the world’s leading grand prix for monohull yacht, the 52 Super Series is a yacht racing circuit like no other. The circuit grew from the ashes of the TP52 MedCup that finished in 2011 in an initiative by three key stakeholders who enjoyed this race so much they wanted to keep it alive.The 52 Super Series embraces like-minded individuals and crews in venues and locations enjoyed by all. This is a series for the best. From Olympic medallists to America’s Cup victors, the dockside is filled with talent.Watch the racing circuit as yachts speed well over 20 knots and representing sailors from over 20 different nationalities in this sustainable event. Competitors race on a simple first-past-the-post format, so real time racing is all that matters, as there is no post-race time compensation.Find out what makes the 52 Super Series the best monohull racing in the world.

programme.title: Semaine De Saint Barthelemy, 2013
programme.desc: From 800 to 900 sailors, from 17 different countries, are expected to come to the Caribbean island of St. Barths for this event. As usual, St. Barths is ready to offer its best qualities, both ashore and at sea, in order to welcome all these people keen on nice sailing races, in the delightful setting of these islands.

programme.title: MAR
programme.desc: Surfing has ceased a long time ago to be considered a niche sport. As the mainstream industry discovers its potential for selling clothes, trips and a whole set of ‘lifestyle’ products, there are those who appreciate it for what it is in its purest form - a direct connection to mother nature. We accompany Big Wave surfer Alex Botelho and some of his friends to meet surfers who balance their love for the ocean and nature with a professional career in the sport. Mar is a tale of discovery, triumph and (almost) tragedy, but above all it is a life affirming pledge to positive vibes in and out of the line-up. Get ready to soak up a new conception of the world of surf as Alex Botelho unveils concepts unknown for the mainstream audience, available on Nautical Channel. Awards: Best Feature Documentary - Best Istanbul Film Festival 2021. Official Selections 2021: Ocean Film Festival World Tour, International Ocean Film Festival.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship, 2025 - - GP of Indonesia
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: 2023 - GP Lake of Toba - Ski division GP1 and Ski Ladies After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.desc: Speed is the name of the game in this episode as we visit Dutch shipyard Heesen Yachts, renowned builder of record breaking, fast, lightweight aluminium superyachts. We talk to naval architects ‘Omega’ and we get an onboard look at the racing colour design of M/Y Aurelia, designed by Bannenberg & Rowell. Finally, no yacht would be complete without the latest technology and fastest onboard gadgets. We discover just what’s hot on a yacht with the most sought-after tech and AV firm, IdeaWorks.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts
programme.desc: Italians are known for their quality and style, and their superyachts are no different. Undoubtedly the largest and most famous of Italian builders is Perini Navi, makers of one of the most ecologically friendly superyachts in the world, the Maltese Falcon. We meet with designer Ken Frievokh and engineer Damon Roberts to understand the technology behind their ground-breaking dyna-rig onboard the Maltese Falcon.We then take a look at some of the finest Italian boats built by one of the fastest growing shipyards: Mondomarine. We get an all access introduction to Viareggio’s Sealyon, whose opulent and glamorous interiors were designed by Martin Kemp at Candy & Candy.

programme.title: The South To Sian Journals
programme.desc: While filming South To Sian, a pair of adventurers dived into what began as a three-month trip and turned into a two-year odyssey of exploration.On boards, bikes, by boat and four-wheel drive, Harrison Roach and Zye Norris discovered if, in these days of GPS and WiFi, the dream of a true pioneering surf adventure is still alive.South to Sian Journals is a collection of stories documenting the people, places & adventures that occurred during the 2 years making South To Sian - the challenges, the surfers, riders, shapers, bike builders, filmmakers and photographers.Extremely entertaining and insightful, Journals documents the travels, the hardships, the spectacular locations, the personalities and the thoughts of the characters, both in front of and behind the lens.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris, 2014 - 2014
programme.desc: The annual event to discover the nautical novelties of the coming season. A showcase of close to 785 exhibitors and 1,300 brands for an attendance of over 240,000 visitors, 1200 boats on display including nearly 200 new features!

programme.title: Jump On Board, 2013: Greece
programme.desc: We are approaching our end of our trip and the next stop is Skiros. With the morning breeze we leave past the serene and calm location behind us on route to Skiros. Local dances, fun and life at sea are some of the things Greece has to offer, and in this short time we have seen how great friendships have started.

programme.title: 52 Super Series
programme.desc: 2026 - - 52 Super Series Sailing Week Established as the world’s leading grand prix for monohull yacht, the 52 Super Series is a yacht racing circuit like no other. The circuit grew from the ashes of the TP52 MedCup that finished in 2011 in an initiative by three key stakeholders who enjoyed this race so much they wanted to keep it alive.The 52 Super Series embraces like-minded individuals and crews in venues and locations enjoyed by all. This is a series for the best. From Olympic medallists to America’s Cup victors, the dockside is filled with talent.Watch the racing circuit as yachts speed well over 20 knots and representing sailors from over 20 different nationalities in this sustainable event. Competitors race on a simple first-past-the-post format, so real time racing is all that matters, as there is no post-race time compensation.Find out what makes the 52 Super Series the best monohull racing in the world.

programme.title: Semaine De Saint Barthelemy, 2013
programme.desc: From 800 to 900 sailors, from 17 different countries, are expected to come to the Caribbean island of St. Barths for this event. As usual, St. Barths is ready to offer its best qualities, both ashore and at sea, in order to welcome all these people keen on nice sailing races, in the delightful setting of these islands.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Vodice is a famous tourist destination known for many breathtaking beaches and vibrant and rich offer of all tourist attractions. It is known for its liveliness and its friendly hosts. Located on the coast in a wide bay, 11 km northwest ofŠibenik, it is the ideal vacation spot for everyone. Check it out in this episode of Sail-ho Croatia!

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: The region of Imotski is a historical name for the area. We are determined in today's episode to visit this region and a town straight out of a fairytale - magical Imotski. We’ll indulge in natural beauties and set off across the sea to the islands of Iž, Molat and Dugi otok. Stay with us and find out more about this wonderful area!

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Kite Masters is a series showcasing the latest news from the inspirational world of kite boarding - the action packed sport which continues to take the world by storm. Whether you are a kiteboarder - competitor or recreational, kiteboarding fan, interested observer or have ever wanted to give kiteboarding a go, then you are guaranteed to enjoy the Kite Masters series. There are a myriad of different disciplines in kiteboarding - racing to freestyle - for weekend warriors and the professional riders. Kite Masters checks in on them all and brings you the best round up of action from around the world.

programme.title: Ortaci, film
programme.desc: Priča o malim ljudima koji svoju egzistenciju pokušavaju osigurati na periferiji velikog grada, u miljeu tržičnog "podzemlja", sumnjivih privatnih inicijativa, sitnih prevaranata i nerealnih ambicija. U taj svijet stiže mladić iz provincije sa namjerom da studira. Ali, umjesto studija, on se upušta u sumnjive poslove sa svojim zemljacima, probisvjetima, doživljavajući razne zgode i nezgode u potrazi za lakom zaradom.

programme.title: Šećerna vodica, film
programme.desc: „Dečka je studentica tehničkog fakulteta, djevojka pomalo muškobanjastog izgleda i ponašanja, koja zapravo ne uspijeva riješiti svoje adolescentske traume. Neprilike u koje se sama dovodi i nevolje koje radi drugima opravdava svojim „groznim izgledom - velikim nosom i ogromnim stopalima. Misleći kako sve svoje traume može riješiti jednim potezom, ona odluči, umjesto na ekskurziju, otići na plastičnu operaciju. Radnja filma prepuna je komičnih zapleta, a film je rađen u stilu američkih „limunada filmova namijenjenih adolescentima u kojima se miješaju melodrama i komedija. U vrijeme premijere film je bio vrlo popularan i rado gledan, a osvojio je i više nagrada. Na filmskom festivalu u Puli glavna glumica Sonja Savić dobila je Zlatnu Arenu za najbolju žensku ulogu.

programme.title: Enklava, film
programme.desc: Ostvarenje koje je imalo svetsku premijeru na 43. FEST-u, pripoveda o srpskoj zajednici koja je ostala da živi na Kosovu u enklavama. Tema nije iz novina - rušenje groblja ili kamenovanje autobusa. To je samo okvir za suštinu Enklave - a to su identitet i opstanak Srba u Pokrajini. Film obrađuje temu srpske zajednice koja je ostala na Kosovu da živi u malim izolovanim zajednicama - enklavama. Primorani na ovakav život, ograničeni da žive na skučenom prostoru, Srbi koji su ostali da žive na Kosovu i Metohiji žive svoje živote na veoma težak način. Šta se dešava kad neko premine u enklavi, a groblje se nalazi van nje, na neprijateljskoj teritoriji? U ovoj priči, uz mnogo peripetija, jedan osamdesetogodišnji starac će, ipak, biti sahranjen zahvaljujući svom unuku, desetogodišnjem dečaku koji se usudio da učini nešto nemoguće za obe zajednice na Kosovu, i srpsku i albansku: da zavoli i stekne prijatelja na suprotnoj strani. Iskusnu glumačku postavu od Nebojše Glogovca, preko Anice Dobre do Miodraga Krivokapića, svojom iskrenošću nadograđuju dečaci naturščici Srba i Albanaca s Kosova i Metohije, koji dočaravaju male, a već velike ljude čije su sudbine odraz sveopšte drame.

programme.title: Uvek spremne žene, film
programme.desc: Sedam žena, sedam gubitnica. Nezaposlene, bez krova nad glavom, bez obitelji, bez uzvraćene ljubavi. U kontaktu i sudaru sa svijetom, uglavnom svijetom muškaraca, one gube, ali uvijek se ponovno vraćaju u borbu. Grupa se osipa. Neke bivaju pobjeđene životom, a neke same sobom. Preostale guraju dalje, same protiv svih.

programme.title: Sutjeska, film
programme.desc: Teritorij Bosne i Hercegovine, 1943. godine. Nakon što se obznanilo da njemačke trupe pristižu u Jugoslaviju, na pomolu je velika bitka koja bi mogla odnijeti mnogo žrtava. Partizanski vođa Tito (R. Burton) svjestan je opasnosti u kojoj se nalaze on i njegovi ljudi: njih dvadeset tisuća, zajedno sa središnjom bolnicom, opkoljeni su u bosanskim vrletima. Uslijedit će teške borbe, tijekom jednog proboja i Tito će biti ranjen, a mnogo će hrabrih ljudi poginuti... Film "Sutjeska" Stipe Delića, uz "Bitku na Neretvi" Veljka Bulajića, najpoznatiji je jugoslavenski cjelovečernji film NOB-u. Rekonstrukcija je to jedne od najmučnijih vojnih operacija koje su se dogodile na teritoriju bivše Jugoslavije, u kojoj je poginulo s obje strane više od sedam tisuća boraca (među poginulima je bio i opjevani narodni heroj, Titov pouzdanik, Sava Kovačević). Atraktivno je režiran, prepun spektakularnih i napetih ratnih prizora, ali se podjednako usredotočuje na psihološke dileme vrhovnog zapovjednika, kao i na potresne sudbine pojedinaca. Unatoč nekim nedostacima koje mu je predbacivala kritika (stereotipni likovi boraca i patetika), publika je dobro prihvatila film (čime su pridonijeli i slavni glumci, prvenstveno R. Burton) te ga je ovjenčala nagradom Jelen na Pulskom festivalu 1973. Film je osvojio i Zlatne arene za najbolji film, scenarij i najboljeg glumca (Lj. Samardžić), te brončanu za režiju. Film je snimljen 1973.

programme.title: Nacionalna klasa, film
programme.desc: Humoristična drama o samoživom automobilistu koji se i pored neukrotive osobne prirode nađe zatočen u egzistencijalnom beznađu. Branimir Brane Mitrović zvani Floyd 27-godišnji je beogradski automobilist koji se uoči odlučujuće trke nalazi na trećem mjestu u ukupnom poretku u tzv. nacionalnoj klasi do 785 kubika, tj. u konkurenciji zastava 750, popularnih fića. Floyd je samoživ i neodgovoran zgubidan kojeg otac mesar stalno kritizira a majka tetoši, i koji uporno izbjegava poziv za služenje vojnog roka, tek formalno upisujući svake godine novi fakultet. Tako se sad odlučio na studij glume, gdje uoči prijemnog ispita upoznaje privlačnu Senku koju smjesta poželi, nimalo se ne obazirući na osjećaje svoje poluslužbene djevojke Vukosave zvane Šiljo. Međutim, Šiljo mu priopći da je ostala u drugom stanju, a njezini imućni roditelji, u dogovoru s Floydovim, ne pitajući ništa o tome Floyda i Šilju, pripreme svadbu... Nacionalna klasa do 785 ccm drugi je cjelovečernji igrani film Gorana Markovića, istaknutog pripadnika beogradskog ogranka tzv. praške škole kinematografije socijalističke Jugoslavije. Marković je debitirao dvije godine ranije Specijalnim vaspitanjem koje je smjesta steklo kultni status, dok je Nacionalna klasa bila manje kritički uvažena, ali prihvaćena od publike i rado gledana. Njezin središnji lik tipični je predstavnik karakterizacijskih stremljenja praške škole u tematiziranju suvremene urbane omladine (pa i šire): izdvojeni individualac koji se ne uklapa u društveno okruženje, međutim nepovratno je u njemu zarobljen što mu egzistenciju čini, bez obzira na njezinu eventualnu dinamičnost (kao u ovom slučaju), dubinski sumornom. Dragan Nikolić odličan je u ulozi u kakvima je nerijetko nastupao tijekom svoje karijere, dakle onoj anarhoidnog mladog čovjeka kao više ili manje dalekog izdanka Godardova Michela Poiccarda iz slavnog filma Do posljednjeg daha (tumačio ga je Jean-Paul Belmondo), s tim da ovdje njegov lik - za razliku od Godardova - ne skončava (apsurdistički intoniranom) nasilnom smrću kojom zapravo zadržava svoju slobodu, nego biva zarobljen nametnutim mu okovima malograđanskih životnih nazora. Sličan lik, lik Džimija Barke, tumačio je Nikolić i u klasiku Živojina Pavlovića Kad budem mrtav i beo, a Živojin Pavlović u Nacionalnoj klasi pojavljuje se u maloj cameo-roli. Spomenimo da naslovnu pjesmu filma pjeva Dado Topić, a da se među izvođačima pjesama uvrštenih u film nalaze i Oliver Dragojević, Slađana Milošević, Oliver Mandić i braća Vranešević.

programme.title: Krvava bajka, film
programme.desc: Kragujevac, prvi dani okupacije, prve nevine žrtve. Partizanski odred djeluje u blizini grada i u okršaju gine desetina neprijateljskih vojnika. Naređenje je kratko: za svakog Njemca streljati 100 građana. Toga dana, grupa malih čistača cipela odbila je da očisti prljave njemačke čizme. I njih odvode na streljanje. Kragujevac je postao grad crnih zastava i crnih marama, a posmrtna zvona zvone, jer se drži opelo za 7000 streljanih.

programme.title: Kuduz, film
programme.desc: U sumornom ambijentu gradske periferije počinje priča o lokalnoj zavodnici koja se udaje za doskorašnjeg robijaša Kuduza (Slobodan Ćustić), čovjeka kojeg razapinju strasti. Početni nesporazumi i praštanja između supružnika, a zatim potjere i svađe, mirenja i molbe, neminovno vode ovu vezu dvoje ljudi elementarnog naboja tragičnom završetku. On će izvršiti zločin. Za sve vrijeme ove burne veze odvija se plemenita, nježna i kristalno čista ljubav između poočima Kuduza i njegove petogodišnje pastorke.

programme.title: Virdžina, film
programme.desc: U zabitom kršu na prostorima Kninske krajine, obitelji bez muškog potomstva smatrane su ukletim i osuđenim na propast. Da bi se spasile prokletstva, te obitelji su jedno od ženske djece proglašavale "virdžinom", tj. muškarcem, skrivajući istinu kao obiteljsku tajnu. U jednoj takvoj obiteljii koja zna samo za krš, gudure, ovce i sv. Đurđa, svoga zaštitnika, najveće blago je sin kojeg nikako da dobiju. Zato će posljednja, tek rođena djevojčica biti žrtvovana da postane "muško" usprkos bolu majke, kako bi kuća ponovo dobila naklonost zaštitnika - sveca. Osuđena da poništi sve žensko u sebi, da se bori sa vlastitom prirodom i osjećajima, u trenutku kad se zaljubi u prijatelja, počinje se buniti svim bićem protiv osuda. Što se otac više trudi da nosi breme za oba muškarca, vjerujući da se sve može prikriti i pred svijetom i pred svecem, sve se više gubi i pada. "Virdžina", uz pomoć mladića kojem otkriva tajnu, raskida sa starim životom i kreće, kao mnogi iz tog kraja, na put u Ameriku.

programme.title: Sabirni centar, film
programme.desc: Stari arheolog pronalazi rimsku nadgrobnu ploču za kojom je tragao čitavog života. Ona pokriva prolaz s „ovog na „onaj svet. Pri pokušaju da je pomakne profesor doživljava srčani udar i ubrzo umre. Ali, mrtav samo za okolinu, on se u stvari nalazi u nekoj vrsti stanja „između života i smrti. Kako je i živ i mrtav u isto vreme, uspostavlja vezu između živih i mrtvih, pa mrtvi, vođeni željom da vide svoje rođake, kreću prolazom koji je profesor otkrio ispod rimske nadgrobne ploče, u susret svojim voljenim na „ovom svetu. Ali, svet živih nije onakav kakvim su ga zamišljali.

jazzahead! 2022, Modern
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community's most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2022, jazzahead! paid special attention to Canada’s jazz scene and invited forty jazz acts from all over the world to perform over the course of three days. Among the performing artists are vocalist Kim Zombik and double bassist Nicolas Caloia. The music of this Montreal-based duo, which goes by the name of Silvervest, is characterized by tenderness, humor and tunefulness. The band’s name pays homage to an item of clothing favored by the indefatigable and endlessly creative legendary drummer Elvin Jones.

programme.title: Arsenik - Olympia, Paris, Rap
programme.desc: The mythical duo Arsenik is a rap group from France, made up of two brothers, Lino and Calbo. The team performs at Olympia Paris to celebrate their 20 years since their first album, Quelques gouttes suffisent… It’s a unique concert: Arsenik plays the entire album with numerous special guests for the first time. The album has sold over 300,000 copies in France. Today it’s being considered a classic, and it continues to be cited in the top five of the best French rap albums of all generations. Enjoy Arsenik’s live show in Olympia Paris!

programme.title: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats, Jazz
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua

programme.title: WOMEX 2018, World
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria. One of its showcase participants, Mario Batkovic, aims to explore the sonic possibilities of the accordion, without effects or loops, rather through a mutualist symbiotic relationship between man and instrument. Challenging, hypnotic, and grandiose, Batkovic’s single-handed symphonic vision is certainly unique.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson, Modern
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson. The repertoire consisted of a selection of compositions by Shearing himself, among them ‘Lullaby Of Birdland’, which is a standard in jazz repertoire.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Club: Marnix Busstra Band, Modern
programme.desc: Guitarist, composer and director Marnix Busstra loves crossing borders. He travels the world with his jazz bands, plays guitar and bouzouki, writes jazz and theatre-songs, and co-creates and directs the exuberant theatre shows of his wife, the Dutch diva Karin Bloemen. Busstra is a constant wheel of invention, with technique expanded by his creative urge to find something new, an evolving state that adds immeasurably to his art. The Marnix Busstra Band was founded in 2011 by its namesake. Joined by piano talent Rembrandt Frerichs, the ever creative double bassist Arnold Dooyeweerd and the inspirational force of drummer Pieter Bast, Busstra introduces a unique band that will definitely help broaden the jazz horizon. Marnix’ compositions are the starting point of the band. Musically, this band is a continuation of a development started by the quartet that Marnix co-leads with the renowned vibraphonist, Mike Mainieri. The result can best be described as lyrical, multifaceted jazz that centres around the profound interplay of the four musicians.

programme.title: Sia - Live at The Metro Theatre, Pop
programme.desc: The Australian-born singer-songwriter Sia Kate Isobelle Furler, simply known as Sia, is one of the most unique artists in today's popular music scene. However, her path to stardom has been nothing but rocky. Only after numerous musical experimentations, where the singer tried to establish herself in her home country as well as United Kingdom, Sia finally blossomed in United States around the second decade of the 21st century. The very beginnings of her mainstream recognition was captured on 25 March 2009, where the artist performed live at Metro Theatre in Sydney, Australia.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano, Fusion
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Badbadnotgood, Urban
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.tv have been collaborating for a series of music programmes: ‘BIRD.tv’, allowing you to experience the best BIRD concerts and interviews as from a first row seat! This episode shows you the four-piece jazz/hip hop ensemble BADBADNOTGOOD, whose collaborators include the likes of rapper ‘Tyler, The Creator’, the Haitian-Canadian electronic musician Kaytranada, the vocalist Kali Uchis, and the rapper Ghostface Killah. BADBADNOTGOOD is endlessly inventive: its four members have ultimately crafted their own, lasting mark on hip-hop and electronic beats.

programme.title: Where Are We Now - Part I, Modern
programme.desc: German jazz and cabaret singer Atrin Madani was born in 1998 as the son of Iranian immigrants. In the face of pandemic uncertainty, geopolitical upheaval, and social unrest in his ancestral home country, Madani asked himself: where are we now? His response to this question is as clear and precise as his singing: what we need most right now is honesty, humility, and quality. All of these are abundantly present on the Berlin-based vocalist’s debut album. Inspired by the sound aesthetics of Mel Tormé, Norah Jones, Diana Krall, and Till Brönner, Madani dedicates himself to a handpicked selection of songs that have so far remained largely unsung in jazz. At this festive album release concert at jazz club A-Trane Berlin in March 2023, Madani was accompanied by pianist Christian von der Goltz, guitarist Alexander Rueß, bassist Olaf Casimir, and drummer Sebastian Merk. Part I.

programme.title: For Heaven's Sake, Concert
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In October 1968, two former colleagues met again on stage, this time leading their own bands at the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam: drummer Art Blakey and pianist Horace Silver were both co-founders of The Jazz Messengers.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan - Maria, Concert
programme.desc: Arguably the greatest lady vocalists of all time are featured in this superb compilation. These historic recordings from the 1950s and 1960s offer a unique overview of different approaches to jazz singing that helped define the genre. Watch Billie Holiday’s performance of God Bless The Child closely and learn what made her such an influential jazz and pop singer. Enjoy Anita O’Day’s matchless rhythmic sense in a performance of Honeysuckle Rose recorded at the Arenateatern in Stockholm, Sweden on November 1, 1963. Marvel at Nina Simone’s December 1968 performance of Ain't Got No, I Got Life from London. Let Sarah Vaughan’s rendition of Tenderly sweep you off your feet - ‘Sassy’, or ‘The Divine One’, recorded this romantic evergreen in a television studio in Sweden on July 9, 1958. Last but not least, revel at the ‘First Lady of Song’: Ella Fitzgerald swung Mack The Knife in a December 4, 1960 appearance at The Embers in suburban Melbourne, Australia. Get to know the greatest lady vocalists in jazz history with this unique compilation of historic recordings!

programme.title: My Funny Valentine, Concert
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. Among the many talents in the Orchestra were trumpeter Clark Terry, trombonist Quentin Jackson, saxophonist Johnny Hodges and violinist Ray Nance.

programme.title: Ella Fitzgerald - Antibes Jazz Festival, Jazz
programme.desc: The 1964 edition of the Antibes Jazz Festival in Juan-les-Pins saw the return of the First Lady of Song, Ella Fitzgerald. Together with Roy Eldridge on trumpet, Tommy Flanagan on piano, Bill Yancey on double bass, and Gus Johnson on drums, the tireless singer performed such classics from the Great American songbook such as 'Them There Eyes', 'The Lady Is a Tramp', 'Summertime', 'I'm Putting all My Eggs in One Basket', 'St. Louis Blues', and 'Perdido', and a few novelties, such as Steve Allen and Ray Brown's 'Cutie Pants'. It is no surprise this legendary concert from Juan-les-Pins was released on LP!

programme.title: Blue Note: A Story of Modern Jazz - Part II, Jazz
programme.desc: Art Blakey, Dexter Gordon, Ron Carter, Herbie Hancock, Thelonious Monk... these names are synonymous with the great Jazz Age. But how many people know Alfred Lion and Francis Wolff, to whom we owe the recorded memory of our Jazz legends? Two German Jews who emigrated from Nazi Germany to New York "discovered" an American art form which at the time received little serious attention from mainstream America: Jazz Music. Without money or connections and speaking little English, the two men began to record practically unknown musicians, following their own taste and judgment. Today this list of artists reads like the Who-is-Who of Jazz. "Blue Note - A Story of Modern Jazz" tells the story of Alfred Lion and Francis Wolff and their record label. It is the story of the rise of Modern Jazz, of a friendship in exile and of uncompromising artistic excellence. Told by the musicians, by friends and associates and by fans of the Blue Note recordings from all walks of life, the film Blue Note recreates an era of American cultural history.

programme.title: Classic Meets Jazz, Modern
programme.desc: Tzimon Barto, the young American classical pianist and Wolfgang Dauner, the internationally renowned German jazz pianist join their talents to show how multi-dimensional music can be.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II, Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, legendary swing band leader jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed two sets with his septet at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. True to form, with his concert the 'King of Swing' revisited the atmosphere of the swing era - the 1930s - when jazz enjoyed tremendous popularity. Goodman's septet includes Scott Hamilton (tenor saxophone), John Bunch (piano), Phil Flanigan (double bass), Mel Lewis (drums), Warren Vaché (trumpet), and Chris Flory (guitar). Here is the second of two sets recorded at the festival in 1982.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Rosenberg meets Beets, Fusion
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, Toots Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age. And though music was in their blood, neither parent associated the word musician with a career. In this broadcast, Peter Beets teams up with gipsy jazz heros Stochelo Rosenberg, Martin Limberger and Frans van Geest. The strength and precision of Van Geests' rhythms and tempo, and the ease with which Stochelo's lead guitar soars above them, make this band a cohesive collective - unique in their renditions of standards, Django's classic compositions, and original tunes composed by Stochelo himself.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival, Modern
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart. Situated at the Valletta waterfront outside Our Lady of Liesse Church, Horn’s concert was a truly spellbinding experience.

programme.title: Funk in Deep Freeze, Concert
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians - guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse - accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s Crystal Bells, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include Down and How Deep is the Ocean.

programme.title: Songs She Never Heard, Concert
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic stretch music; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah’s quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne, Fusion
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Bireli Lagrene, Fusion
programme.desc: Biréli Lagrène is a French jazz guitarist born on September 4, 1966 in a family of gypsy tradition. His brother and his father introduced him from an early age to the repertoire of Django Reinhardt, whose influence is still felt in the style of Lagrène. In this performance, Lagrène pays homage to Django Reinhardt with his son, Babik Reinhardt.

programme.title: Naima, Concert
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs Autumn Leaves, Hackensack, My Favorite Things, I Want To Talk About You, Vigil, and Naima. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone, Concert
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone. After that, she continued her career with the release of ‘Nome de Mar’, which received many positive reviews. At the moment, Maria Ana is performing at all Portugal’s major venues, as well as many festivals and concert halls throughout the world, with the aim to present fado music and Portuguese culture to other cultures. Bobone’s latest album, ‘Fado & Piano’, shows her diversity as an artist, composer and arranger. By including the piano she re-innovates the tradition of the early 20th century. This portrait shows Maria Ana’s performances and interviews in which she explains her passion for fado music and culture.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois, Modern
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour. The PC QWINTETT consists of several highly acclaimed Dutch jazz musicians with whom Courbois has worked before in his long and versatile career. Among them are pianist Nike Langenhuijsen, double bassist Egon Kracht, trumpeter Toon de Gouw, and trombonist Ilja Reijngoud. QWINTETT honours the Charles Mingus tradition of thematic and melodic ensemble jazz - but also with an unmistakable Courbois groove! Courbois, known for his own way of combining compositions with improvisations, melodically melts constructions with uneven breaks.

programme.desc: Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. programme.desc: Danas gotovo da nema sportske aktivnosti, Olimpijskih igara, sportskih organizacija, a da tu nema žena. Žena je postala nezaobilazan i značajan faktor o kom god sportu govorili. Neke dame su u svojim sportskim disciplinama ostavile takav trag da se o tome priča i pričaće se. Druge su asistirale kao treneri, organizatori, sudije, ali nepobitno je da lepši pol svojim znanjem i sportskim umećem uzdignute glave šeta ovom planetom.

programme.title: Heroji Halijarda, film
programme.desc: Do sada neispričana ratna priča o tragici jednog vremena, o herojstvu i beznađu, o prijateljstvu, žrtvovanju i plemenitosti, o ljubavi i dobroti...

programme.title: Specijalno vaspitanje, film
programme.desc: Petar Antić - Trta živi sa majkom u velikom siromaštvu pa hranu i novac nabavlja krađom. Policajac Cane blagonaklon je prema malom džeparošu, ali nakon što su mu uhapsili majku, Trtu su odveli u popravni dom. U popravnom domu stanje je haotično, tuče i podmetanja svakodnevica su štićenika. Ali u dom dolazi novi vaspitač, Žarko Munižaba sa malo drugačijim metodama rada.

programme.title: Željko Vasić: Da pređemo na ti
Arhiv. doc: Retrospektiva i perspektiva
programme.desc: Emisija kojom obeležavamo 67. rođendan Radio-televizije Beograd sačinjena je od arhive iz vremena samih početaka, izgradnje zgrade televizije na Sajmu davne 1958. godine, nabavljanja prvih televizora, koji će uskoro osvojiti čitav naš prostor, ali i od snimaka iz prethodnih 20 godina sa rođendanskih skupova namenski pravljenih za ljude koji su gradili televiziju.

programme.title: Znamenite žene srpske prošlosti: Nadežda Petrović
Kamera je prisutna: Momci i devojke sa samita
programme.desc: Druga epizoda dokumentarnog serijala Kamera je prisutna, donosi priču o festivalu skejtbord kulture Samit nesvrstanih. Provokativno ime za one koji se sećaju Josipa Broza Tita svakako asocira na ujedinjenje i snagu alternativnih ideja, što na savremen i apolitičan način korespondira sa aktuelnom skejterskom verzijom Samita nesvrstanih, festivala koji je osnovan sa idejom da ujedini skejt scenu u Srbiji, citiramo jednog od osnivača festivala i glavnog junaka u filmu - Davida Milosavljevića. Film Momci i devojke sa Samita je intiman portret nekoliko osnivača i glavnih aktera ovog neobičnog događaja, koji spaja umetnost i alternativni sport, koji je ove godine čak postao zvanična olimpijska disciplina. Epizoda pokriva šesti Samit nesvrstanih, programski bogat i veoma posećen urbani hepening koji se odigrao leta 2021. godine. Samit nesvrstanih je skup skejtera, umetnika, zidara i muzičara. Samit na kojem ćeš upijenu energiju proslediti dalje i tako ohrabriti i sebe i druge da rade ono što stvarno vole. - citat sa sajta ove energične grupe mladih koji zaista verno prenosi ono što su autori ove epizode serije Kamera je prisutna želeli da prenesu gledaocima RTS-a. Urednik dokumentarne redakcije i projekta: Olivera Pančić Reditelj i scenarista: Gregor Zupanc

programme.title: Džez klub, 18. emisija
programme.desc: U 18. epizodi serijala "Džez klub" predstavićemo Vam bend "Schime", kvartet koji svira savremenu muziku, džez koji je baziran na tradiciji, ali sa modernijim pristupom samom zvuku i aranžmanima.

programme.title: Serija sa audiodeskripcijom: Nobelovac, Savez, serija
Beogradska filharmonija: A. Šenberg - Peleas i Melisanda
programme.desc: Simfonijska poema „Peleas i Melisanda" op. 5 Arnolda Šenberga, inspirisana Meterlinkovom dramom, a nastala na podsticaj Riharda Štrausa 1902, premijerno je izvedena 1905. godine.

programme.title: Beogradska filharmonija: A. Šenberg - Peleas i Melisanda
programme.desc: Simfonijska poema „Peleas i Melisanda" op. 5 Arnolda Šenberga, inspirisana Meterlinkovom dramom, a nastala na podsticaj Riharda Štrausa 1902, premijerno je izvedena 1905. godine.

programme.title: Koncert grupe Jarboli
programme.desc: Grupa „Jarboli", nastala je početkom devedesetih u Beogradu i sama sebe žanrovski označava kao istočnoevropski rokenrol, a slušaoci je svrstavaju, pre svega, u široku oblast alternativnog, to jest indi popa. Formirali su je Boris Mladenović, Daniel Kovač, Nemanja Aćimović i Žolt Kovač, a kasnije im se pridružila i pijanistkinja Sonja Lončar.

programme.title: Fantastična planeta: Ekstremna planeta, 1-9 2C
programme.desc: Druga sezona dokumentarnog serijala Fantastična planeta u 18 epizoda otkriva najskrivenije delove naše planete. Vladimir Banić obišao je sve poznate kontinente i razgovarao sa više od dvesta sagovornika.

programme.title: Sabotaža
programme.desc: Dokumentarni film „Sabotaža" donosi potresnu i dugo prećutkivanu priču o ženskom pokretu otpora u logoru Aušvic-Birkenau. Svedočenjem Ane Vajcblum Hajlman, najmlađe članice ove pobunjeničke mreže, pred nama se otvara priča o hrabrosti, solidarnosti, nadi i tragičnim izborima u najmračnijim okolnostima.

programme.title: Put u budućnost: Braco i tri priče o Bojsu, serija
programme.desc: Priču počinjemo malim ogledom o liberalnom kapitalizmu, u gradu bez građana, sa istorijom bez vremena, festivalom bez festivala. Počinjemo u Dubrovniku gde upoznajemo Bracu Dimitrijevića, jednog od retkih umetničkih anđela koji stoje na samom vrhu igle umetnosti skraja 20. i početka 21. veka. U priči o Braci i sa Bracom, za trenutak zastajemo da čujemo tri rašomonske priče o Jozefu Bojsu, njegovoj poseti Beogradu 1974. godine, nastupu na Aprilskim susretima i SKC-u i svemu što se potom dogodilo.Autor: Boris Miljković

programme.title: Do detalja
programme.desc: Zašto su eros i tanatos neraskidivo povezani, gde je granica između života i literature i kada je pisac u potpunosti zadovoljan napisanim, pitanja su na koja za Do detalja odgovara Goran Gocić koji je, kao i glavni junak njegovog romana, bio fikser, prevodilac i pomoćnik stranim novinarima u vreme rata u bivšoj Jugoslaviji.

programme.title: Život u okupiranom Beogradu 1941-1944: Horizontalna kolaboracija i sport, serija
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi dokumentarne serije Život u okupiranom Beogradu 1941-44, sagovornici, istoričari i svedoci govore o sportu, o prostituciji tokom okupacije... Najposećenije su bile fudbalske utakmice, jer je fudbal najjednostavnije organizovati. Na jednoj utakmici BSK i BASK-a bilo je osamnaest hiljada gledalaca. O navedenim temama govore istoričari i svedoci: Branislava Ristović, Breda Kalef, dr Ljubinka Škodrić, dr Nataša Milićević i dr Nikola Mijatov. Scenario i režija Nenad Milošević

programme.title: The Jazz All Star Trio: Richard Galliano Trio
Đorđe Marjanović: Milord, serija
programme.desc: Idol mnogih generacija, Đorđe Marjanović, veliki Milord, učitelj brojnih estradnih ličnosti, umetnik koji je ostavio neizbrisiv trag u razvoju domaće muzičke scene. I u doba najveće slave, kada je punio dvorane i stadione širom SFRJ i SSSR-a, većina ga je obožavala; bilo je i onih koji su ga kudili, ali su svi bez razlike jednostavno morali da mu odaju priznanje za trud, želju, ljubav i umeće koje je darovao publici.

programme.title: Mama i tata se igraju rata, serija
programme.desc: Glavni akteri ove humoristične serije su supružnici Veljko (Gordan Kičić) i Jadranka (Nina Janković), čiji brak nakon nekoliko godina ulazi u ozbiljnu krizu. Veljko je glumac koji još uvijek čeka svoju veliku ulogu, a Jadranka je arhitektica koja nosi gotovo svu odgovornost njihovog zajedničkog života na svojim leđima. Njihova drama nastaje kada Jadranka priopći Veljku da se želi razvesti od njega.

programme.desc: U sklopu emisije uz nedjeljna čitanja i evanđelja, te njihove komentare predstavljaju se pjevački zborovi i orkestri svih župa Varaždinske biskupije koji u emisiji sudjeluju pjevanjem duhovnih pjesama. Nerijetko su za glazbeni dio emisije «Vjera i nada» zaslužni članovi brojnih tamburaških i glazbenih sastava, te kulturno umjetničkih društava koji se svojim nastupima i koreografijama predstavljaju odjeveni u narodne nošnje našega kraja.

programme.title: POPEVKE I ŠTIKLECI, iz VTV arhive: zabavna emisija
programme.desc: Kroz emisiju približavamo gledateljima kajkavski kraj, zanimljive ljude i kulturnu baštinu. Zagorci, Međimurci, Podravci, ali i ostali kojima je KAJ u duši u svakoj će od emisija pronaći nešto za sebe - glazba poznatih pjevača i sastava kajkavskog kraja, zanimljive priče i legende, ali i posebnosti koje svojim sadržajem odražavaju duhovitost, vrijednost tradicije te bogatu i znimljivu povijest i puno dobre zabave.

programme.title: ČOVJEK I BOG, dokumentarna emisija
programme.desc: Njemačka emisija o religiji Čovjek i Bog u 30 minuta trajanja bavi se propitivanjem odnosa Boga i čovjeka, u razgovornoj dokumentarističkoj formi jedan na jedan.

programme.title: VTV TJEDNIK, informativna emisija
programme.desc: donosi pregled najvažnijih događaja u Gradu Varaždinu, Varaždinskoj i Međimurskoj županiji koji su obilježili protekli tjedan. Sve te događaje prikazujemo ponovno, ovoga puta u novom svjetlu, promatrajući ih s vremenske distance, uz najnovije informacije i komentare. Pregled je realiziran tako da se po danima (od ponedjeljka do subote) ponove opširne vijesti koje su obilježile pojedine dane. Emisiju «VTV tjednik» realiziramo s komentarom za slušno oštećene osobe, čime smo uspjeli, na veliko zadovoljstvo, približiti naš informativni program i toj skupini naših gledatelja.

programme.title: PUTOPISI, dokumentarna emisija
programme.desc: Jurica Galić Juka profesionalni je fotograf, svjetski putnik, putopisac, stalni suradnik časopisa Meridijani i snimatelj dokumentarnih filmova iz Splita. Do 2022. godine obišao je više od 70 država na 5 kontinenata, piše putopise i izrađuje video dokumentarce. U fotografiji je dobitnik dvadesetak nacionalnih i svjetskih nagrada, a izlagao je samostalno trinaest puta.

programme.title: FESTIVAL KAZALIŠNIH AMATERA MEĐIMURJA, snimka predstave
programme.desc: Manifestacija okuplja kazališne amatere iz cijelog Međimurja koji se mnogobrojnoj publici predstavljaju sa svojim najnovijim predstavama.

programme.title: Boje zemlje
programme.desc: Poljoprivredna emisija Boje zemlje donosi vijesti iz svijeta poljoprivrede. Upoznajemo vas s radom poljoprivrednika u Istri, ali i šire. programme.title: VTV TJEDNIK, informativna emisija
programme.desc: donosi pregled najvažnijih događaja u Gradu Varaždinu, Varaždinskoj i Međimurskoj županiji koji su obilježili protekli tjedan. Sve te događaje prikazujemo ponovno, ovoga puta u novom svjetlu, promatrajući ih s vremenske distance, uz najnovije informacije i komentare. Pregled je realiziran tako da se po danima (od ponedjeljka do subote) ponove opširne vijesti koje su obilježile pojedine dane. Emisiju «VTV tjednik» realiziramo s komentarom za slušno oštećene osobe, čime smo uspjeli, na veliko zadovoljstvo, približiti naš informativni program i toj skupini naših gledatelja.

Ljubomora, serija
programme.desc: Nuzhet upozorava Mukerem da bi njihove stare fotografije mogle probuditi Senihinu sumnju. Seniha preuzima inicijativu oko Nuzhetovih autorskih prava i odlučuje angažovati Buraka, što izaziva novi sukob s Halitom i dodatno produbljuje njihovu dugogodišnju netrpeljivost. Halita ponovo sustižu bolna sjećanja na oca i tragediju koja je zauvijek promijenila njegov život. Seniha naizgled pokušava pronaći način da riješi dug Mukeremine majke bez Halitovog saznanja, ali iza svega se kriju njeni veći planovi.

programme.title: Ljubomora, serija
programme.desc: Halit tokom zajedničke večere iznenađuje Nuzheta viješću da je riješio spor oko autorskih prava i povukao tužbu bez njegovog znanja. Seniha zbog toga izgubi kontrolu i pred svima razotkrije tajne o Halitu, Mukerem, Nalan i Turkan, nakon čega Nuzhet posumnja u Nalanine osjećaje i napusti je. Sljedećeg jutra Seniha tajno poziva Mukerem i Nuzheta u stan na Bejoluu, gdje njihov susret budi strah da je otkrila njihovu zajedničku prošlost. Dok Halit pokušava smiriti posljedice porodičnog sukoba, Nuzhet i Mukerem ostaju sami i suočavaju se sa starim emocijama.

programme.title: Za istim stolom
programme.desc: Jedinstveni recepti najboljih kuhara koji nam omogućavaju da manje vremena provedemo u kuhinji, a više u razgovoru za stolom. Za stolom ne dijelimo samo hranu, dijelimo vrijeme, pažnju, ljubav i za istim stolom postajemo bolji. U emisiji 'Za istim stolom' razgovaramo o nečemu što svi poznajemo, ali rijetko o tome duboko razmišljamo - o filozofiji okupljanja za stolom. Da li je ručak samo obrok ili mnogo više? Cilj ove emisije je da ugostimo plemenite goste, podijelimo s njima stil života kao važne lekcije, razgovaramo o vrijednostima života, ali i kvaliteti obroka. Naša opredjeljenost je uvijek za najbolje i to dijelimo i sa gledateljima. Pred nama je sezona izdvojenih tema, posebnih recepata, specijalnih gostiju kroz koju nas vodi Maja Munda.

programme.title: Okusi ljeta s Majom
programme.desc: Emisija OKUSI LJETA S MAJOM je vedra i inspirativna kulinarsko-putopisna emisija koja slavi jednostavne ljetne okuse, domaće namirnice, ali i radost zajedničkog kuhanja. U svakoj epizodi, od ponedjeljka do četvrtka voditeljica Maja Munda priprema brze, ukusne i lako primjenjive recepte prilagođene užurbanom svakodnevnom životu, pokazujući kako od sezonskih sastojaka napraviti obroke pune okusa. Maja u odabranim epizodama odlazi u posjetu domaćinstvima širom zemlje, gdje upoznaje vrijedne domaćine koji uzgajaju vlastito voće, povrće i začinsko bilje u svojim baštama. Zajedno s njima bere svježe plodove, otkriva zanimljive porodične priče i tradicionalne recepte te priprema jela koja spajaju domaću tradiciju i moderne kulinarske ideje. „Okusi ljeta s Majom donose autentične priče, korisne kuharske savjete i pregršt inspiracije za sve ljubitelje dobre hrane, pokazujući da najbolji obroci nastaju od svježih sastojaka, jednostavnih recepata i druženja za zajedničkim stolom. Svaka epizoda poziva gledaoce da otkriju bogatstvo ljetnih okusa i novih brzih, praktičnih recepata koji mogu biti inspiracija za zdrave obroke ovoga ljeta.

programme.title: Mjesto povratka - Život povratnika
programme.desc: „Mjesto povratka se u novoj sezoni fokusira na ljude koji su se unatoč teškim okolnostima odlučili na potez povratka, koji je okarakterisan kao „svjetski fenomen. U ovoj sezoni „Moja povratnička priča biće vodilja emisije kroz direktniji pristup povratnicima i detaljima njihovog povratka.

programme.title: Anatomija života
programme.desc: Nova emisija u programu Hayat TV-a je Anatomija života. Cilj ove emisije jeste da u saradnji sa stručnim osobljem, ljekarima i profesorima gledateljima ponudimo odgovore na mnogobrojna pitanja o zdravlju. Okruženi i „zatrpani različitim zdravstvenim savjetnicima koji se kroz različite platforme nameću bez sigurnih izvora, odlučili smo postaviti emisiju u kojoj će profesionalne i etablirane ličnosti odgovoriti na pitanja o prevenciji zdravlja. Mnogi su simptomi koji upućuju na određene tegobe te mogu biti kobni za život pojedinca. Pomoći ćemo i učiniti sve da pravovremeno svakom gledatelju pružimo zdravstveni savjet. Zdravlje, kao jedna od najvažnijih tema, vodi nas do mnogobrojnih svakodnevnih pitanja koja ćemo pravovremeno komunicirati, a u korist gledatelja i njihovih pitanja. Bit će ovo TV ordinacija u kojoj svi imaju priliku sudjelovati. Naši gosti su ljekari, stručnjaci s dugogodišnjim iskustvom. Briga o zdravlju je i najvažnija tema koja umnogome kreira zadovoljno društvo. Medijski komunicirati i proširiti profesionalne teze kao odgovor na mnogobrojna pitanja o zdravlju naš je zadatak.
